name: citrus_engine_pick_total_ms
description: DISTRIBUTION of `pick.processed.totalMs` (server/src/draft/LobbyManager.ts): authorization + on-clock check + submit_pick_v2 RPC round trip + uWS broadcast, per pick processed through the engine's action queue (today: engine-authored autopicks; manual picks arrive as external events and are measured by citrus_engine_external_event_notify_to_broadcast_ms until WS-direct submit ships). Mandate (CLAUDE.md): manual pick p95 <= 300 ms / p99 <= 500 ms; autopick p95 <= 1000 ms / p99 <= 2000 ms. Label wasAutopick splits the two targets. Value is regex-extracted from the raw JSON line because the gcplogs driver does not parse it (see README). Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh.

labels.description: true = engine-fired autopick (Mandate: p95 <= 1000 ms); false = manual pick through the engine path (Mandate: p95 <= 300 ms).
Docker label `environment` forwarded by the gcplogs driver (production / staging).
